method: All 177 distinct NEAR_MISS_NEEDS_READ locations were read individually against their best same-role native candidate. Two automated rules were tried first and BOTH rejected: a 0.25 Jaccard threshold and a 'shares the longest significant token' rule. Both blessed coincidences -- 'Clear Session' vs 'Capture Session' share only 'session'; 'Legal holds' vs 'Legal notes' share 'legal' but are different product features. Automated extraction is not adjudication, so the verdicts below are a curated reading, not a rule output.

summary.note: The 158 fall through to CONTENT_ABSENT: the requirement is not implemented on the native counterpart screen and the apparent similarity was a shared common noun.
